title.narrative: A Virtuous Cycle between Health Services Delivery and Human Capital Development: Evaluating the spillover and scale effects of Community Health Workers Professionalization in Zambia

description.narrative: This project aims to assess the educational spillovers of a public service delivery initiative within the health sector, previously examined by Ashraf et al. (2020). Beyond the notable health impacts identified in the evaluation, we hypothesize that the program's benefits may extend significantly beyond its primary health focus. Specifically, we believe that communities where Community Health Assistants (CHAs) were recruited and stationed – as of the better health and higher job aspirations – might be more likely to have initiated a self-reinforcing positive feedback loop which we call "Virtuous Cycle".
